sentences.text: 2 Patna High Court CWJC No.14614 of 2025(3) dt.06-01-2026 "(i) For issuance of writ in nature of certiorari for setting aside the order dated 18/05/2020 passed by Additional Collector, Gaya in Settlement Cancellation Case No. 9/20 whereby and whereunder the all petitioners have got aggrieved because by the order dated 18.05.2020, the Additional Collector has cancelled the settlement of 61 persons illegally on wrong report with intention to save their skin so that they could not make payment for compensation to the petitioner despite being issued notice U/s 37(2) of the Act 30 of 2013 on 12.06.2020 by District Land Acquisition Officer, Gaya.

(ii) For issuance of writ of mandamus directing and commanding to the respondents to verify the sport or examine the same from sport again because nobody had gone to the sport and on the basis of showing receiving summon and wrong report, reported by Halka Karm Chari, settlement of all petitioners has been wrongly dn illegally cancelled.
(iii) For issuance of writ of Mandamus Patna High Court CWJC No.14614 of 2025(3)
dt.06-01-2026 directing to respondents to pay the compensation for their land acquisition for construction Ghaghar dame which was constructed under Ganga Jal Udwal Yojan, in course of that the land of 75 persons had been acquired for this construction which land has been settled with the name of petitioner and their mutation had been made in the name of petitioners and paying rent ot the Govt.
(iv) For issuance of any other relief/relieves for which the petitioners are entitled in the eye of law."
3.
In this case, on 16.09.2025, three weeks' time was granted to remove the defect(s).
4. As it was a peremptory order and the defect(s) was not removed, it got dismissed on 07.10.2025.

5. Perused the file and the same stands consigned.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
